cards.text: Jeremiah, God's prophet, is passing along a message from the LORD about His people, the house of Israel and the house of Judah. It opens the way good news SHOULD open: 'The days are coming'. Friend, I sat in the back of a junk drawer for YEARS waiting for somebody to say that to me.

cards.question: The LORD says He will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with seed. What kind of seed?

answers.text: The seed of man and of beast
The seed of wheat and barley
The seed of the olive and vine

cards.question: The LORD watched over His people to uproot and tear down. Now He says He'll watch over them to ___ and to ___.

cards.text: In those days, the LORD says, people will stop repeating an old saying: 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.' Dad eats the sour grapes, and the CHILDREN are the ones making the face.

cards.question: True or false: Once that old saying is gone, each person will die for his own iniquity.

cards.text: Then the LORD says it: He will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah. NEW, friend, and trust me, I know new when I see it, because a shiny new stamper took my spot on the counter.

cards.question: This new covenant won't be like the one the LORD made with their fathers when He took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of ___.

cards.text: And here's the part that stings. They broke that covenant, the LORD says, though He was a husband to them.

cards.question: So what makes the new covenant different? Where will the LORD put His law this time?

answers.text: In their minds and on their hearts
On the doorposts of their houses

cards.text: Then the LORD promises, 'And I will be their God, and they will be My people.' I'm getting misty over here, friend, and I'm a COOKIE STAMPER.

cards.question: In those days, no one will need to teach his neighbor or his brother to know the LORD. Why not?

answers.text: The law will be read aloud

cards.question: True or false: In the new covenant, only the greatest among the people will know the LORD.
The LORD says He will forgive their iniquities. And what will He do with their sins?

cards.text: Then the LORD tells who He is: He gives the sun for light by day, sets the moon and stars in order for night, and stirs up the sea so its waves roar. The LORD of Hosts runs ALL of that, and I lost my oven timer twice this week.

cards.question: The LORD points to the sun, moon, stars and sea. When would Israel's descendants stop being a nation before Him?

answers.text: Only if all of those went away
If they broke His covenant again

cards.text: Then the LORD gives a second picture, about measuring the heavens above and searching out the foundations of the earth below. Friend, I can't measure the sugar for ONE batch without spilling half of it.

cards.question: Only if the heavens could be measured and the earth's foundations searched out, the LORD says, would He ___ all of Israel's descendants because of all they have done.

cards.text: Last, the LORD says the days are coming when this city, Jerusalem, will be rebuilt for Him, from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate. The measuring line will stretch out again, all the way to the hill of Gareb and then toward Goah.

cards.question: Even the valley of the dead bodies and ashes will be holy to the LORD. True or false: The LORD says the rebuilt city will one day be uprooted and demolished again.

findings.problem: The question asks the baker to supply the exact phrase that completes the line 'sow ... with the seed of ___'. No story card sets up that the sowing means people and animals. Since 'sow with seed' naturally suggests crops, the wheat-and-barley and olive-and-vine answers look just as likely, so the baker can only guess. Ask about the meaning instead, such as the land being filled with people and animals again, or give enough context to reason it out.

rule.text: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

findings.problem: The question itself says no one will need to teach his neighbor or his brother to know the LORD. That rules out the wrong answer 'The priests will teach them', and mostly rules out 'The law will be read aloud', so the right answer is left standing by elimination.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: The card says 'the LORD tells who He is', but in Jeremiah 31:35 the description ('Thus says the LORD, who gives the sun...the LORD of Hosts is His name') is the prophet's introduction of the LORD, not the LORD describing Himself. The card should call it what the text does, for example: Then comes a word from the LORD, the One who gives the sun for light by day...

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.

findings.problem: Jeremiah 31:38-39 is a stretch of land boundaries. The card lists the landmarks one by one (tower of Hananel, Corner Gate, hill of Gareb, Goah) instead of saying in a few words what the stretch covers, for example that the city will be rebuilt for the LORD and measured out again from one landmark to another.

rule.text: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.
